verdict.rationale: Formant is a robot fleet operations platform with an on-device agent, so a hardware-abstraction story is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence shows no stable sensor or actuator abstraction interfaces that would let application code survive hardware swaps. The closest items are uniform data ingestion across robot types, cross-vendor fleet orchestration and agent adapters, which are adjacent telemetry and fleet features rather than a hardware-abstraction layer.
